Ei'lor (also known as The Star-Seed) is a Great Old One in the expanded Cthulhu Mythos. The character was originally created by American author James Ambuehl for his short story "The Star-Seed".

page.overview:
What is Ei'lor?

Ei'lor (also known as The Star-Seed) is a Great Old One in the expanded Cthulhu Mythos. The character was originally created by American author James Ambuehl for his short story "The Star-Seed".

Dwelling in a vast cavern beneath a rural farming village in the United Kingdom, not much is known about the entity named Ei'lor, save for what is briefly mentioned in the occult texts collectively known as The Revelations of Gla'aki. What is known is that it shares many similarities with the Green God; both appear to be composed entirely of vegetable matter, are capable of extruding vine-like tentacles to capture their victims, and both offer some kind of perverse communion to their depraved cults. These two entities also inhabit subterranean lairs in the same region of England, the Severn Valley.

Ei'lor is known to have, via its seedlings, have infested the planet of Kr'llyand - located "near enigmatic Tond and revolving around the green sun of Yifne and the dead star of Baalblo" - with its monstrous growth. After viewing the paintings of one Thomas Jeffreys, Royceton University's Davis Rault fears that this may become the fate of Earth under the fertile attentions of Ei'lor. (: "Correlated Contents")

Ei'lor and its seed are also further discussed in the tome the Ei'lor Fronds. (: "The Star-Seed")
